name: ZImage timestep noise (random sigma jitter fed to the model)
plain: A model wrapper that, inside a progress window, hands the model a randomly perturbed sigma instead of the real one, to make different seeds diverge more on flow models such as Z-Image/Lumina2. Flow mode adds a uniform offset limited by the headroom to 0 and 1 and clamps to [0,1]; sigma mode multiplies by a factor in [1−s/2, 1+s/2]. With a MASK it runs the model twice (real and jittered sigma) and blends the outputs by the mask. Surprises: the offset range is asymmetric near the ends, so it is not zero-mean there; progress is found by matching the sigma to the nearest entry of the SIGMAS input; and the jitter seed is seed + a call counter that is never reset, so a reused patched model gives different jitter on the next run.
math:
Symbols: σ sigma passed to the model (the wrapper's 'timestep'); s strength; u ~ U(0,1) seeded seed+call.
flow: d_up=min(s,1−σ), d_dn=min(s,σ); σ̃ = clamp(σ + u(d_up+d_dn) − d_dn, 0, 1).
sigma: σ̃ = σ(1 + (u−0.5)s).
out = model(x, σ̃) in window, or (1−m)·model(x,σ) + m·model(x,σ̃) with a mask.

props.extra_model_calls: 0, or 1 per call when a mask is connected
props.params: sigmas (required, for progress), mode flow|sigma (default flow), noise_strength 0.05, seed, start_percent 0.0, end_percent 0.5, optional mask
